text:
Ella (Sales): Quick handoff for Meridian Health - enterprise contract signed (12mo Dedicated). PoC passed; procurement signed DPA. Passing to CS for onboarding.

Ella (Sales): Customer needs: Okta SSO+SCIM, VPC peering (preferred window 02:00-05:00 UTC), private model mount for PHI evals, and capacity plan for 3 rps steady with 8 rps bursts.

Priya (CS): I'll lead onboarding. Owners: Priya (onboarding), Aisha (infra/peering), Devin (smoke tests & prompts), Sam (support/runbook).

Priya (CS): Pre-kickoff asks: contact email for their infra team, public ASN, expected daily QPS curve, and any special compliance docs.

Ella (Sales): Contact is infra@meridianhealth.com (Tariq). ASN: 64512 (pending final confirmation). I'll confirm the curve by EOD.

Aisha (Eng): Infra note: need CIDR allowlist and ASN to configure routes. HSM ETA for Dedicated ~6 weeks; KMS with customer-managed keys available now. Will post a compliance note for procurement.

Devin (Solutions): I'll prepare a 10-prompt smoke set and a tiny python harness for latency checks, upload to /shared/meridian. Quick curl for post-SSO smoke: curl -X POST https://dedicated.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-ded","input":"ping"}'

Sam (Support): I'll create ticket MH-101 "Meridian onboarding" and add checklist: SSO, SCIM, peering, model mount, smoke tests, canary cutover. Also will prep 30-day oncall plan.

ops-bot: Ticket MH-101 created by Sam (Support) - https://support.redwood.ai/MH-101

Priya (CS): Action items: Priya: schedule kickoff + weekly checkpoints; Aisha: validate peering + KMS note; Devin: upload tests; Sam: populate MH-101 and oncall.

Ella (Sales): Procurement asked for a provisional credit clause: 7% if p95 > 300ms for 60 days. Legal agreed to conditional language. Flagging for CS risk register.

Aisha (Eng): I'll run a staging capacity test tomorrow and post numbers to MH-101. Preliminary: 220-260ms p95 @512 tokens on a40-class with continuous batching.

Priya (CS): Success metrics to track: go-live within 30 days, p95 <300ms at steady load, SSO+SCIM functional, smoke pass, zero Sev1 first 14 days. Kickoff Thurs 15:00 UTC - I'll send invite.

Ella (Sales): Thanks team. I'll join kickoff and hand off to Meridian AM.

Priya (CS): Great handoff. Owners, please update MH-101 as you make progress."
